dish: Tuna tartare avocado stack on artichoke bruschetta with a Sriracha drizzle (Akron Life); braised short rib sliders, bourbon-glazed pork chop
w: Eclectic global small and large plates by chef Jeff Herman inside a Romanesque 1840s stone mansion on Lincoln Way, opened July 2021. Named one of USA Today's Restaurants of the Year for 2025, one of only three in Ohio, and profiled by Akron Life. Massillon's destination table.

dish: The huge gyro, plus souvlaki platters in beef, chicken, lamb or seafood
w: A Greek-rooted Stark County mini-chain, serving oversized gyros and Mediterranean plates since 2001, with three Stark locations (this one on Cleveland Ave NW, plus Everhard Rd/Belden Village and Alliance). Picked by the Canton Repository's foodie panel among 11 Stark County favorites; Akron Life's Flavor blog called it the 'papa of all gyros.'

dish: Hand-made pasta and the double-boned local pork chop
w: A downtown Canton Tuscan-inspired kitchen using local ingredients: hand-made pastas, Prime steak, seafood. Chosen by the Canton Repository's foodie panel as one of 11 Stark County restaurants to eat your way through, and featured by Visit Canton among downtown's dining anchors.

dish: Filet mignon with button mushrooms; veal four ways over linguine or angel hair
w: A family-owned Belden Village steakhouse whose lineage goes back to the 1940s, when it was The Hob Nob. Akron Life's 'Winning Eats in Canton' singled out its filet and its Italian-style veal; Visit Canton lists it for 'the best steaks in town.'

dish: Lattes from vanilla to habanero, made with Hartzler Family Dairy milk, plus local scones and cookies
w: Lindsey King's 2019 coffee shop in a repurposed gas station, a bright orange-and-white building in Canton's Logan neighborhood about five minutes from the Pro Football Hall of Fame. Ohio Magazine and Akron Life (twice) have featured it, and Cleveland Magazine put it among Canton's 21 must-go spots.

n: Mike's Pizza & Deli Ohio (Fourth Street Collective)
dish: Thin-crust New York-style pizza from house-fermented dough (Mike's, evenings); Deli Ohio sandwiches by day
w: A downtown Canton shared space: Deli Ohio's window-lined sandwich shop by day, Mike's Pizza's New York-style pies by night, with The Woodshop brewery bar from UnHitched Brewing's Adam Longacre. The Canton Repository picked Mike's among 15 must-visit eateries for Hall of Fame visitors and Deli Ohio among its 10 Stark lunch spots. Ohio Magazine's '12 Reasons to Visit Canton' sends readers here.

address: 119 S Canal St, Canal Fulton, OH 44614
dish: Burgers and sandwiches with cold drinks, steps off the Towpath
w: A family-owned neighborhood bar and grill since 1994, just off the Ohio & Erie Canal Towpath Trail in Canal Fulton. Ohio Magazine picked it as one of three just-off-the-trail bars, a stop for cyclists and St. Helena III canal-boat riders. Visit Canton includes it in its Canal Fulton must-dos.
